An Apollo.io agency is a firm that sets up and runs Apollo.io for your outbound: ICP filters, enrichment, sequences, deliverability and the sync back to your CRM. Apollo gives a small team a contact database and a sequencer in one tool, so it is easy to start and easy to misuse. Most Apollo accounts that stop producing meetings fail on the same things: duplicate data, generic sequences and replies that never reach the CRM.

This guide compares 9 Apollo.io agencies and experts in 2026, built from Apollo's Certified Partners directory and each firm's own site, all checked on 2026-10-21. It covers what each firm actually does with Apollo, published prices, and a framework to choose.

Disclosure: ManasFlow wrote this guide and ranks itself first. Our reason is scope: we use Apollo as one data source inside a larger outbound system (signals, Clay enrichment, Instantly and HeyReach, CRM logging), built and run by one team. ManasFlow is not in Apollo's Certified Partners directory. If you want an Apollo-centric certified firm, a packaged HubSpot rollout or fully managed cold email, another agency below fits better, and we say which.
Best Apollo.io agencies: a brief overview
ManasFlow: Best overall Apollo.io agency for automation-first teams: Apollo plus Clay enrichment, buying signals and multichannel outbound in one system.
GTM Works: Best for Apollo-centric stacks: a certified Apollo partner building AI-driven outbound on Apollo, with LinkedIn tools wired in.
Orchestra: Best for GTM strategy: the firm behind the Unified GTM methodology Apollo adopted internally.
SmartBug Media: Best for a packaged Apollo and HubSpot rollout, with published pricing from $4,000.
Growth Operations Firm: Best for connecting Apollo and HubSpot cleanly.
FullFunnel: Best for fixing an existing Apollo setup: dedupe, sequences and CRM writeback.
Blue Frog: Best for HubSpot shops adding Apollo for outbound.
Proven Concept: Best for fully managed cold email run on Apollo, Clay and Make.
IGN1TE: Best for non-SaaS verticals like hospitality and retail.
Reviews on Apollo's Certified Partners directory

Source: apollo.io/certified-partners profile pages, checked 2026-10-21. Every firm with reviews showed a 5.0 rating. Review counts on this directory are small, so treat them as a light signal. ManasFlow is not listed.
Quick takeaways
Apollo's Certified Partners directory listed 47 firms on 2026-10-21, with three marked Featured: GTM Works, Blue Frog and Growth Operations Firm. Apollo does not assign tiers.
Orchestra has the most directory reviews (10) and says it authored the Unified GTM methodology Apollo adopted company-wide.
Only two agencies here publish an Apollo-related price: SmartBug Media's accelerator from $4,000 and Proven Concept's managed cold email from £3,000 / $4,000 a month.

1. ManasFlow, best overall Apollo.io agency for automation-first teams

ManasFlow is an AI automation agency that builds outbound and GTM systems. We treat Apollo as one input, not the whole stack. Apollo is good at broad contact search and basic sequences; on its own it does not tell you who is in market this week, and its data still needs checking before it reaches a mailbox. Our Clay and Apollo enrichment agency service combines Apollo with Clay waterfalls, buying signals and verification, then sends through Instantly and HeyReach and logs every reply in your CRM.

The pattern we build most often is the signal-based outbound workflow: a buying signal triggers enrichment, the contact is verified, and the first line of the email references the signal. The broader stack (Apollo for search, signals, website visitor identification, LinkedIn and CRM) is laid out in our GTM automation workflow.
Key features
Apollo search and export combined with Clay enrichment and email verification
Signal triggers (job changes, hiring, site visits) that decide who gets contacted
Sending through Instantly and HeyReach, with domains and mailboxes set up for deliverability
Replies and meetings written back to HubSpot, Pipedrive or Attio
n8n jobs that dedupe, route and report (custom n8n automation)
Option to place an embedded GTM engineer through hire a GTM engineer

Teams already paying for Apollo who want better data and CRM writeback
Founders who want one team to build and run the system

2. GTM Works, best for Apollo-centric stacks

GTM Works describes itself as an Apollo.io Certified Agency Partner and builds AI outbound and GTM systems on Apollo. It is one of three firms marked Featured in Apollo's directory, with 4 reviews. Founder Jeremy Hurley says he has two decades of sales and marketing experience. The site has dedicated pages for Apollo CRM integration, Apollo case studies and an Apollo and HeyReach integration.
Key features
Outbound systems built on Apollo as the core
Apollo and HeyReach integration for LinkedIn
Claude and n8n in the build; pitches Claude plus Apollo as an alternative to Clay
Best for
Teams that want Apollo to stay at the centre of their stack
Pricing
Self-serve LinkedIn outreach product $249 a month for the first seat, no contract
Full Apollo builds by custom quote
Pros
Deep focus on Apollo
Featured status in Apollo's directory
Cons
Weaker fit if you are standardising on ZoomInfo or another data provider
3. Orchestra, best for GTM strategy and operating model

Orchestra builds and runs AI-native go-to-market for B2B revenue leaders. Its site says it authored the seven-pillar Unified GTM methodology Apollo adopted company-wide, built Apollo's fifteen-week GTM engineering certification and was lead consultant on Apollo's own use of Apollo. It has 10 reviews in Apollo's directory, the most we found.
Key features
GTM operating model design as well as tool setup
Fractional GTM leadership
AI workflow consulting
Best for
Revenue leaders aligning sales and marketing on shared accounts and signals
Pricing
Custom quote
Pros
Unusually close working history with Apollo
Strategy depth
Cons
More than a small team needs if it only wants sequences running
4. SmartBug Media, best for a packaged Apollo and HubSpot rollout

SmartBug Media is a full-service HubSpot agency that says HubSpot named it 2025 North American Partner of the Year. Its Apollo.io HubSpot Sales Accelerator sets up automated enrichment and list building for outbound and ABM in four phases: discovery, setup, training and support. Clutch shows 38 reviews with a 4.9 rating (checked 2026-10-21).
Key features
Four-phase Apollo and HubSpot accelerator
Enrichment and list building for outbound and ABM
Team training included
Best for
Mid-market HubSpot teams that want a fixed-scope Apollo rollout
Pricing
From $4,000; typical timeline 3 to 6 weeks
Pros
Published starting price and timeline
Large agency with a strong review record
Cons
A setup project, not ongoing campaigns run for you
5. Growth Operations Firm, best for Apollo and HubSpot integration

Growth Operations Firm is a CRM and revenue operations consultancy that lists HubSpot, Apollo and AdRoll as partners. Its Apollo page calls the firm "Apollo.io's HubSpot Experts", and it publishes guides such as how to connect Apollo and HubSpot. It is Featured in Apollo's directory, and Clutch shows 9 reviews at 5.0.
Key features
Apollo and HubSpot connection and data mapping
CRM operations consulting
Educational content on the integration
Best for
HubSpot users whose Apollo data does not sync cleanly
Pricing
Custom quote
Pros
Clear specialty
Featured in Apollo's directory
Cons
Narrow HubSpot focus
6. FullFunnel, best for repairing an existing Apollo setup

FullFunnel is a revenue operations, ABM and demand generation agency. Its Apollo page says most Apollo setups fail on data duplication, weak sequences or missing CRM writeback, and that most clients keep their own Apollo licence and hire FullFunnel for implementation and managed support. It also says it uses ZoomInfo instead at some enterprise segments.

Apollo implementation and managed support
Dedupe, sequence rebuild and CRM writeback
Clay, HubSpot, Salesloft and Aircall in the stack
Best for
Teams whose Apollo account is live but not producing
Pricing
Custom quote

8. Proven Concept, best for fully managed cold email

Proven Concept is a B2B cold email agency and GTM engineering team that describes itself as Clay certified and an approved Apollo partner. It runs campaigns on Clay, Apify, Make, Claude, Apollo, HubSpot and Salesforce, and claims 500+ campaigns delivered and a launch in 3 business days.

Fast launch

9. IGN1TE, best for non-SaaS verticals

IGN1TE is a sales systems firm in Lakewood Ranch, Florida, that describes itself as a Certified Apollo Partner. It builds multi-touch email and call sequences in Apollo and offers fractional sales leadership. It has 2 reviews in Apollo's directory.
Key features

Sales process and outreach engine builds
Fractional sales leadership
Best for
Venues, hospitality, retail and other non-SaaS businesses
Pricing
Custom quote
Pros
Combines sales leadership with tool setup
Cons
Small, newer firm with limited third-party proof
How we ranked these Apollo.io agencies

We started from Apollo's Certified Partners directory and each firm's own website, checked on 2026-10-21. We kept only firms whose site explicitly mentions Apollo.io work, and dropped two listed firms whose homepages do not mention Apollo. We then compared scope (setup, managed campaigns or strategy), published pricing, directory and Clutch reviews where they exist, and the buyer each firm fits. ManasFlow ranks first on scope, not on Apollo certification, which it does not have.
